name: Brake Fluid, Bleeding & Bedding
description: Fluid choice, fill, bleed sequence, bedding procedure and between-session service. Glycol DOT 4 racing fluid with a high dry boiling point is the standard for road racing; it absorbs moisture, so it is replaced often.

components.name: Brake fluid
components.description: Transmits pressure; its boiling point is the limit of the whole system on track. Racing DOT 4 fluids have dry boiling points of 310–325 °C but wet points fall quickly with moisture, hence frequent bleeding.
components.location: Entire hydraulic system: reservoirs, masters, ABS, lines, calipers.

factory.name: GM-approved brake fluid per owner's manual (DOT 3 typical for GM – verify; GM fluid also feeds the clutch master)

raceOptions.name: Castrol SRF React Performance
raceOptions.notes: Very high wet boiling point – long interval between full flushes.

raceOptions.name: Motul RBF 660 Factory Line
raceOptions.notes: Very high dry boiling point; bleed every event.

specs.Type: DOT 4 glycol racing fluid (do not mix with DOT 5 silicone)
specs.System capacity: ≈ 1.0 L (estimate); buy 2–3 L per event for bleeding

installNotes: Use sealed, fresh bottles; never reuse bled fluid.
Clean up spills immediately – glycol fluid strips paint.
inspection: Bleed calipers before every event (and between days if the pedal grows).
Full flush every 2–3 events or at season start.

sources.title: LSX Mag – Chevrolet Performance ZL1 Brake Upgrades For Our Track Camaro (bleed sequence, bedding)

components.name: Bleeding procedure (system service item)
components.description: Sequence: farthest from the master first – RR, LR, RF, LF; on each Brembo/AP caliper bleed the INNER bleeder first, then OUTER. Keep reservoirs full throughout. With the factory ABS, finish with the scan-tool automated ABS bleed. With dual masters, bleed each circuit from its own reservoir.

factory.name: GM manual / pressure bleed + scan tool ABS bleed

raceOptions.name: Pressure bleeder (≈ 15–20 psi) or two-person pedal method

specs.Order: RR → LR → RF → LF, inner then outer bleeder

installNotes: Gravity-prime calipers, then pressure- or pedal-bleed.
After bleeding, hold firm pedal for several minutes engine running (factory booster) – pedal must not sink.
Torque bleeders (front 17–20 N·m, rear 11 N·m) and refit caps.
inspection: Pedal height and firmness check before every session.

sources.title: LSX Mag – Chevrolet Performance ZL1 Brake Upgrades For Our Track Camaro (bleed sequence, bedding)
TightTorque – Chevrolet Camaro 6 (2016–2024) torque table, compiled from GM 2016–2018 Camaro service manual sections

components.name: Pad & rotor bedding procedure (system service item)
components.description: Lays an even transfer film of pad material on the rotor; skipping it causes judder and inconsistent bite. Generic procedure (follow pad maker if different): several moderate on/off applications building heat up to ~65 mph, then 8–10 firm stops from 55–65 mph down to ~25 mph without stopping fully, then a cool-down lap/drive without using the brakes, and let the brakes return to ambient before racing.

raceOptions.name: Pre-bedded discs/pads (Essex offers a $100 disc burnishing service with kit purchase)

installNotes: Never hold the car stationary on the brakes immediately after bedding (pad imprint on hot rotor).
inspection: Even grey transfer film across the rotor face indicates good bedding.
